title: Aesthetic Passport v0.9
description: The assembled product object. Every downstream surface (web report, share card, PDF, image preview, eval, future history/A-B) reads this. Provenance is explicit: `analysis` = what the model said; `derived` = what the rules layer computed; `input_quality`/`anchors`/`color_measurements` = what CV measured.

schema_version.description: 0.7 (Issue #41): optional reference_percentiles (rules layer) — additive, so 0.3–0.6 documents stay valid. 0.6 (Issue #31, D36): optional aesthetic_score (scoring layer) — additive, so 0.3–0.5 documents stay valid. 0.5 (V3B, D35): photo roles profile90 / noglasses, measurement_profile views, side and smile metrics, catalog counts, per-metric source photo, derived.measurement_insights.assessments — all additive, so 0.3–0.4 documents stay valid. 0.4 (V3A, D34): adds measurement_profile (CV) and derived.measurement_insights (rules), both optional so 0.3 / 0.3.1 documents stay valid. 0.3.1 (V2.1): adds beauty_filter_suspect to input_quality issues.

user_context.description: User-declared only. Nothing here is inferred from photos.

presentation.description: User-selected vocabulary domain (makeup vs grooming advice, examples). Never inferred.

body.description: User-entered only; never measured from photos.

anchors.description: Deterministic MediaPipe measurements on the front photo. Relative ratios only; no absolute color, no 'golden ratio'. Null when the front photo failed QC.

face_length_width_ratio.description: (forehead-top landmark → chin) / cheekbone width. Forehead-top is NOT the hairline.

face_shape_heuristic.description: CV-layer face-shape heuristic over the same ratios (adapted MIT heuristic, weights in config/rules.yaml). Fit scores, not probabilities. Report §9.

thirds.description: Vertical thirds (hairline→glabella, glabella→subnasale, subnasale→chin) as fractions of the measured span. When the forehead is covered or the hairline is not found, upper is null and middle + lower = 1.

eye_fifths.description: Face width at eye level in units of the mean eye width: [outer-left, eye, gap, eye, outer-right].

iris_px.description: Mean horizontal iris diameter in px on the working image (glasses size scale).

cheekbone_px.description: Cheekbone width in px on the working image (with iris_px: glasses size).

intercanthal_px.description: Inner eye-corner distance in px (bridge width).

color_measurements.description: CV layer: regional median colors on the front photo (CIE Lab, L 0-100). A signal for the model and the rules, never displayed as a verdict (D15). Report §6 measured chips and §9.

warmth_b.description: skin b* (yellow-blue); higher = warmer-looking in this photo

measurement_profile.description: V3A (D34) CV measurement profile on the front photo: our own deterministic definitions (config/face_metrics.yaml) on MediaPipe landmarks in a head-roll-corrected frame. Relative values only, no score, no millimetres. Overlay coordinates are NOT stored here: they live in geometry.json and expire with the photo (24 h). Null when the front photo could not be measured; absent in passports older than 0.4.

eyewear.description: Glasses in the front photo: declared at upload or detected (QC hint).

value.description: Relative value (ratio, fraction, degrees, Lab). Null whenever not measured — never estimated.

components.description: Per-side values for bilateral metrics (image_left / image_right = the photo's left / right).

overlay.description: Which named points (geometry.json → points) the face page draws for this metric. Names only, never coordinates.

silhouette.description: Draw the traced profile outline (side view geometry).

source_photo.description: The photo this value was measured on (V3B).

locked.description: Free view: the value exists in the full passport; value, components and overlay are removed server-side.

views.description: One entry per measurement photo role (V3B).

capture.description: User-confirmed framing (crop box in source pixels, rotation, source size).

catalog.description: How the 176-candidate research pool is classified (config/face_metrics.yaml catalog_status).

aesthetic_score.description: v0.6 (Issue #31, D36) AI 面部美学参考分: deterministic geometric harmony score computed by src/aesthetic_passport/scoring from the front photo's CV landmarks (never by the model). overall = 0.35 symmetry + 0.25 thirds + 0.25 fifths + 0.15 golden_ratio (config/scoring.yaml). A geometry reference, not an attractiveness verdict and not a population rank (percentiles: #41, separate field). Null on documents older than 0.6.

status.description: full = all four components on a good photo; limited = computed but a photo-condition flag lowers confidence; unavailable = no overall score.

overall_score.description: 0–100, one decimal; null unless all four components were measured.

measured.description: The raw geometry behind the component score (shares, eye-width units, ratio, residuals).

derived.description: Computed by src/aesthetic_passport/rules.py from analysis + anchors + user_context + config/rules.yaml. Never produced by a model.

seasonal_leaning.description: Shown only when the gated rules pass (D15); null otherwise. Report §6.

hair_references.description: Rules layer: closest entries of the adapted hairstyle catalog (config/hairstyles.json) for the model's hair_direction and the face shape. Report §5 参考款式.

style_profile.description: Four layers (D25): observed features live in analysis; here = inferred position (face_only / overall), the user's preference overlay and target. Feedback never moves face_only.

rules_zh.description: config/styles.yaml rules for primary (empty when the file is missing).

guide.description: config/styles.yaml text: the inferred style's summary and examples for the user's presentation, and the transition toward the target style (null without a target).

feedback_applied.description: What the last rerank used and what changed (one-line note for the UI).

derived_version.description: Increments on every rerank of the same passport.

measurement_insights.description: V3A (D34) rules-layer reading of measurement_profile: 看到的 → 意味着 → 所以建议. Bands are illustrative common ranges (config/rules.yaml measurement_insights), never good/bad. Null without a profile.

assessments.description: V3B: the rules layer's assessment of each measured value against an illustrative or literature reference range. Separate from the CV value; never a score.

position.description: Where the value sits on the reference bar (0..1).

target_id.description: hair_options tier (safe|bold|easy) or current, optionally _hc<i> (a hair_color_directions index, V2.1 Look Studio); or a recommendation id.

reference_percentiles.description: v0.7 (Issue #41): approximate position of the aesthetic_score and of frontal ratios inside published, self-selected reference scan cohorts (config/reference_distributions.json; docs/scoring/REFERENCE_DISTRIBUTIONS.md). Rules layer: computed from aesthetic_score and the front landmarks, never by the model. Not a population rank. Null on documents older than 0.7.

higher_is_better.description: Always null: a ratio's size position is never a quality judgement.
